name: Tessallite Excel plugin task pane
description: Structure and behaviour of the Tessallite Excel add-in task pane: the shell (header, project bar, section tabs, banners, footer), the Report Builder, KPI Scorecard and Ask Tessallite sections, the login screen and every overlay the pane owns. Authored from tessallite/excel-plugin/src and tessallite/shared-ui/src/components; props come from the generated declarations under build/ts; strings from src/i18n/strings.ts (keys as i18n) and src/i18n/chatStrings.ts (prefix chatStrings:).
